description: Reads a public website (homepage, sitemap and main pages) and writes a ready-to-upload llms.txt file that tells AI assistants who the business is, what it offers, where it works and which pages matter. Optional details (services, service area, hours, key facts) make it stronger. Use it when an audit shows no llms.txt.

address.description: Street address, city, state and ZIP.

business_name.description: Override the business name found on the site.

key_facts.description: Short facts AI assistants should know: years in business, licenses, starting prices, guarantees, awards.

service_area.description: Where the business works, e.g. 'Kingsport, Johnson City and Bristol, TN'.

services.description: Main services or products, one per item.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the business does, for whom, and where. Overrides the site's description.

name: generate_llms_txt
title: llms.txt Generator
